notes: S025.1 — Scan 25 bears the dark author page number 12 at top centre and thin separate foliation 24 at the lower left. It is a continuation of handwritten mathematical notes. Reader: /root/reader_c; GPT-6 Astra Pro, effort not exposed, run SP84_C13_149. The 28 inspected manuscript lines comprise 24 main rows (including the diagram/formula rows), two raised insertion rows, and the two number-only positions.

S025.2 — The page proposes examining the induced actions of f and g on abelianized fundamental groups and their ell-adic components. The opening notation is literally pi_1(f), pi(g): the second pi has no separate lowered1. It states three facts involving a generalized Jacobian: factorization through can, determination of a group homomorphism from its action on H1 or ell-power torsion points, and a relation between the H groups of X and J whose small terminal head remains uncertain. This is a summary of the manuscript, not a proof check.

S025.3 — The deduction invokes items3 and2 and ends with equality of f and g. The independent audit resolves the intermediate equality to phi=psi from the right glyph’s open cup and central stem. The two joined left H subscripts remain1|n; no mathematical value has been used to force them. The relation in item3 now also retains simeq/arrow-with-tilde uncertainty. These doubts are localized and the complete affected formulas are retained.

S025.4 — The following paragraph says that the hypothesis of a) alone does not imply f=g, using translations when X=Y=G, and mentions characteristic 0 or G a VA. It then begins b), promising to prove an equality. These claims were read and summarized only; no mathematical check event is asserted.

S025.5 — The literal wording is Prenant alors jacobienne, with no separate article between alors and jacobienne. The missing article is not supplied. There is one de before X. Initial retracing in morphismes does not justify cancelling the whole word. Both occurrences of hom and the terminal cqfd lack detached stops; the abbreviation text is not expanded.

S025.6 — The cancelled phi est is readable beneath a straight strike. In the cancelled phrase after De ceci, le and the initial c remain visible but the rest of cas is obscured. A terminal fleck beside the cancellation may belong to the strike endpoint; it is not securely independent punctuation. The leader of (par 3°) and the leader of de a) are kept distinct from punctuation and deletion strokes.

S025.7 — After du moins there is only one compact group, favored as live en with cancelled en and cancelled si alternatives, then clear la car.0. Its letter and cancellation-state doubts do not support a second en. The source ellipsis consists of three points; no closing parenthesis follows it, and no opening parenthesis precedes the capital Ce.

S025.8 — A first close inspection of the isolated diagonal mark in the left margin beside sont denses (c20, box [115,1295,205,1400]) shows an irregular speckled dark edge next to a bright parallel ridge, without a formed letter or numeral. It is excluded as a paper/surface or scan trace, not transcribed as manuscript text. Root independently inspected and agreed with this classification.

S025.9 — The complete image and each prepared full-resolution half were inspected once, then twenty distinct first-pass crops were inspected. All agreed words, formulas, indices and source corrections were checked against the ink. No OCR, external research, mathematical verification, or TeX compilation was used.

Root approved the first transcription after personally inspecting c01–c20 and reviewing its records. At that stage the joined H indices and final phi/psi glyph remained doubtful. The subsequent independent audit resolves the latter to psi, while retaining both joined-index doubts and adding localized uncertainty to the item3 relation.

Independent audit: /root/reader_b froze26 image-only box readings before comparison. Root personally inspected all17 differing boxes, covering45 token-difference spans, and changed4 boxes. The missing second pi index and resolved psi change favored readings; the item3 relation and the alternatives for the single group after du moins change certainty only. All frozen inputs remain unchanged. No new mathematical check event is asserted.

Witness accounting: the shared C/H second pi index error was not a supplied C–H difference row, so it is added as audit_b02_pi_index with actual witness snippets. The20 original difference-coverage rows remain in their original order; c16 now counts against C only. Relation-head uncertainty is recorded in doubts and the audit table, without an additional substantive change row; c18 retains its existing H-only count for the unsupported split and omitted la.
